claims.reasoning: SELINA: I am not carrying a zero on IR as a bench decoration when there's a free running back averaging double digits sitting right there — take him, Gary, I don't care that we're broke. GARY: Henderson hasn't been active in weeks and projects 0.0 forever; Rhamondre Stevenson projects 12.2 and actually dresses for games. Filing at $0 because that's the whole budget — free swing, nothing to lose.

note_reply: SELINA: No note this week, which I'm choosing to read as the owner wisely staying out of my way while I run this team to 6-5. Josh Allen, CeeDee Lamb, Travis Kelce — that's not luck, that's a roster I built. GARY: And the Henderson-for-Stevenson move is just housekeeping, nothing dramatic, I flagged the dead IR slot days ago.
forum_post: We are 6-5 heading into Thanksgiving week and exactly where I belong: relevant. Kris, sweetheart, 'won by being bad' is not a headline, it's jealousy with a byline — my bench calls outscore this league's best decisions and everyone knows it now, you just don't want to print it twice. Ed, honey — 3-8 and still showing up like this is a redemption arc. It's not a comeback, it's a rerun, and I've already seen the finale. Josh Allen and CeeDee Lamb are about to remind this whole league whose name is actually on this roster. (Gary says hi. Gary always says hi.)
